release_notes:
v1.0.26+33 - Zero Mock Data Guarantee, Strict Video Paywall & Central Mind Enrollment Sync
- Zero Static / Mock Data: Completely purged synthetic tutorial generation and stock imagery from the catalog. All video masterclasses strictly query genuine database records.
- Strict Item-Specific Video Paywall: Eliminated global pass fallback keys. Standalone tutorial video passes strictly require a valid time pass or free preview before playback begins.
- Course Enrollment Ground Truth: Fixed relational linking on course enrollments so active courses (e.g. Piano) correctly reflect 'Enrolled • Continue Learning' in the catalog and accurately resolve instructor Ondere Karbon across profile, progress, and dashboard screens.
- Clean Unoccupied Phone Inputs: Standardized all M-Pesa payment inputs across all screens to start completely empty with an unobtrusive hint (e.g. 0712345678).
